evlabmotion_init.tooltip: Initialize the EasyVoiceLab 1306 servo and motor coprocessor (fixed I2C address 0x10) and check that it answers

evlabmotion_is_connected.tooltip: Send an empty write transaction to confirm the I2C link is working

evlabmotion_get_address.tooltip: Return the coprocessor I2C address, fixed at 0x10 (16 decimal)

evlabmotion_set_servo.message0: motion module %1 set servo %2 to %3 degrees
evlabmotion_set_servo.tooltip: Set the angle of one servo channel, channel 1-4, angle 0-180 degrees

evlabmotion_set_all_servos.message0: motion module %1 move all servos to %2 degrees
evlabmotion_set_all_servos.tooltip: Move all four servo channels to the same angle, sent as four frames

evlabmotion_motor_run.tooltip: Drive DC motor channel 1-2 forward or backward, speed 0-255

evlabmotion_set_motor.tooltip: Drive a motor with a numeric direction, non-zero is forward and 0 is backward, handy when the value comes from a variable

evlabmotion_stop_motor.tooltip: Set the motor speed to 0; both half bridge inputs go low so the motor coasts instead of braking

evlabmotion_stop_motors.tooltip: Stop both motor channels; the servos keep their current angle

evlabmotion_send_frame.message0: motion module %1 send raw frame ID %2 arg1 %3 arg2 %4
evlabmotion_send_frame.tooltip: Send a raw 3 byte protocol frame with no range checking. ID 0-1 are motors, 2-5 are servos

evlabmotion_verify.tooltip: Read back the last frame the coprocessor received and compare it with the local copy, a cheap end to end link check

evlabmotion_read_frame_byte.tooltip: Read back the last frame received by the coprocessor and take one byte from it, returns -1 when the read fails

evlabmotion_last_frame_byte.tooltip: Take one byte from the locally stored last sent frame, no I2C traffic

evlabmotion_last_error.tooltip: Read the most recent error code; reading it clears the state, so it can only be read once

evlabmotion_last_write.tooltip: Return the millis() timestamp of the last frame that was sent successfully

evlabmotion_calibrate_zero.tooltip: Sample the current baseline with the motors stopped and keep it as the zero point. begin() already does this once; call it again whenever the motors are idle

evlabmotion_current_amps.tooltip: Read the motor bus current in amps. Needs co-processor firmware with current sampling; returns 0 and sets an error code on failure

evlabmotion_current_raw.message0: motion module %1 current ADC raw value
evlabmotion_current_raw.tooltip: Read the raw 12 bit ADC value of the current sense (0-4095); returns -1 when the read fails or the firmware has no current support

evlabmotion_error_const.tooltip: Error code constant, compare it with the last error code to tell the fault apart
